t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the Genomes fall under 2 categories. Category 1 will take you to the bright forest, the Genome colors that fall under these category are orange, green, red and blue. Category 2 will take you to the dark forest, the Genome colors that fall under these category are brown, pink, yellow, purple. In the order the colors are listed above, they are considered pairs. The objective during the game is to find which category gives you the most mushroomes and that is the category where you will get the most points.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, my advice is based on information I received and my own experience playing the game. The gnomes will appear on your screen in fixed pairs.The gnome you pick will lead you to one of two forest (2 categories): Bright Forest and Dark Forecast. In your first few rounds you need to identify which FOREST will give you the greater number of mushrooms.   Here are the fixed pairs and 2 categories:Bright Forest | Dark ForestOrange         | Brown Green           | PrinkRed              | Yellow Blue              | PurpleFor example, if the first round you pick Orange which gives your 2 mushroom and the next round where the same pair appears and you pick Brown which gives you 8 mushrooms. you have identified the category Dark Forest give you more points and you should consistently pick the colors under Dark Forest.    Tips: you only have 1.5 seconds to pick a gnome and click space bar to pick the basket. keep this in mind and be quick. When a white square appears around your selection that's when the games registers your pick. I suggest clicking the key just 2-times to ensure you pick is registered. Good luck!
